## `client.grants`

The `grants` resource of the platform API.

### `client.grants.grant`

Signature: `client.grants.grant(*, principal: str | None = None, group: str | None = None, role: str | None = None, action: str | None = None, kind: str, environment: str | None = None, namespace: str | None = None, table: str | None = None, override_reason: str | None = None) -> Grant`

Create a grant.

Exactly one of `principal`/`group` and exactly one of `role`/ `action` must be given; the server raises `ValidationError` otherwise. `environment`/`namespace`/`table` must match what `kind` expects.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | `str | None` | `None` | Name of the principal to grant to, or `None` if granting to a group. |
| `group` | `str | None` | `None` | Name of the group to grant to, or `None` if granting to a principal. |
| `role` | `str | None` | `None` | A role template to grant, or `None` if granting a raw action. |
| `action` | `str | None` | `None` | A raw action to grant, or `None` if granting a role. |
| `kind` | `str` | required | Which tier of the securable hierarchy this grant applies to: `"INSTANCE"`, `"ENVIRONMENT"`, `"NAMESPACE"`, or `"TABLE"`. |
| `environment` | `str | None` | `None` | The environment, for an ENVIRONMENT/NAMESPACE/TABLE-scoped grant. |
| `namespace` | `str | None` | `None` | The dot-joined namespace path, such as `"gold.sales"`, for a NAMESPACE/TABLE-scoped grant. |
| `table` | `str | None` | `None` | The table name, for a TABLE-scoped grant. |
| `override_reason` | `str | None` | `None` | Why, 10 to 500 characters on one line, to make the grant although an access file manages its scope (an audited override, for an administrator of the instance). |

Returns: `Grant`. The created grant.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If the given fields don't form a valid combination. |
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the named principal, group, or securable does not exist. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If the principal or group already holds the same role or action on the same securable (the message names that grant's id; nothing is created), or an access file manages the scope. |

### `client.grants.list`

Signature: `client.grants.list(*, limit: int | None = None, cursor: str | None = None, **filters: Unpack[GrantFilters]) -> list[Grant]`

List active grants, newest first; every filter is optional and they combine.

The grants of one page; `list_page` also returns the cursor of the next one, and `iter` walks every page.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `int | None` | `None` | Most grants returned (1 to 200); `None` leaves it to the server (100). |
| `cursor` | `str | None` | `None` | A previous page's `next_cursor`. Send the same filters with every page. |
| `**filters` | `Unpack[GrantFilters]` | any number | The filters of `list_page`: `principal_name`, `group_name`, `action`, `environment`, `namespace`, `table`, `kind`. |

Returns: `list of Grant`. Newest first.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If both `principal_name` and `group_name` are given, an object filter has a gap, `action` or `kind` is unknown, `kind` is not the object filter's kind, or `cursor` is not one the server issued for the grants list. |
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | Without the `ADMIN` role on the instance. |

### `client.grants.list_page`

Signature: `client.grants.list_page(*, principal_name: str | None = None, group_name: str | None = None, action: str | None = None, environment: str | None = None, namespace: str | None = None, table: str | None = None, kind: str | None = None, limit: int | None = None, cursor: str | None = None) -> GrantPage`

List one page of grants, newest first, with the cursor of the next page.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal_name` | `str | None` | `None` | Only grants made to this principal. |
| `group_name` | `str | None` | `None` | Only grants made to this group. |
| `action` | `str | None` | `None` | Only grants that give this action. |
| `environment` | `str | None` | `None` | The environment of an object filter. |
| `namespace` | `str | None` | `None` | The dot-joined namespace of an object filter. |
| `table` | `str | None` | `None` | The table of an object filter. |
| `kind` | `str | None` | `None` | Only grants on objects of this kind, in any letter case: `INSTANCE` (the grants on the whole instance, which apply to everything in it), `ENVIRONMENT`, `NAMESPACE` or `TABLE`. With an object filter it must be that object's kind. |
| `limit` | `int | None` | `None` | Most grants returned (1 to 200); `None` leaves it to the server (100). |
| `cursor` | `str | None` | `None` | A previous page's `next_cursor`. Send the same filters with every page. |

Returns: `GrantPage`. The grants, and the cursor for the next page (`None` on the last).

### `client.grants.iter`

Signature: `client.grants.iter(*, page_size: int = 100, **filters: Unpack[GrantFilters]) -> Iterator[Grant]`

Yield every matching grant, newest first, fetching pages as needed.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page_size` | `int` | `100` | Grants per request (1 to 200). |
| `**filters` | `Unpack[GrantFilters]` | any number | The filters of `list_page`: `principal_name`, `group_name`, `action`, `environment`, `namespace`, `table`, `kind`. |

Returns: `Iterator of Grant`. Each grant, once.

### `client.grants.revoke`

Signature: `client.grants.revoke(grant_id: str, *, override_reason: str | None = None) -> None`

Revoke a grant.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grant_id` | `str` | required | The grant's id. |
| `override_reason` | `str | None` | `None` | Why, 10 to 500 characters on one line, to revoke the grant although an access file manages its scope (an audited override, for an administrator of the instance). |

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no grant of this id exists. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If revoking this grant would leave zero active instance admins. |
